en: Talk to Shiji Hirotada to sortie
note: Same pattern as U00150 ('Talk to Shiji Hiroyoshi to sortie').
The ninja's 'Ah!' is unexplained; U03289 shows they dropped something as they fled, so this is probably the moment it falls. Kept as a bare exclamation.
Merchant 3 greeting the established Merchant 1 as a new colleague; with U03293-U03295 these are the newcomer's greetings to the two existing merchants.
Fukubara re-raising the envoy proposal of U03306 when it was not accepted; the choice U03304 follows.

en:
Send Fukubara as envoy
Don't send Fukubara
note: 'Don't send Fukubara as envoy' is 146 px against the 144 px limit, so the second option drops the repeated 'as envoy' (understood from the first option).
Shiji (staff officer) to Motonari before the sortie (label U03283); 'my lord' added for address.
Townsperson 3 has apparently treated the collapsed Ikoma (gender unknown, so singular 'them'). The listener (Motonari) and what was given are not shown.
Compressed from 'Teshima Shogo began to read the letter.' (39 chars, over the 36-character caption limit); 'it' = the letter handed over in U03330.

en:
You ran out of the house,
saying you'd come back
a true craftsman,
and how many years
have gone by since then?

Your mother hasn't forgotten you
for even a single day......

You've always been stubborn,
so could it be that you can't
bring yourself to come home
and don't know what to do?

Even if your work isn't
going well, your mother doesn't
mind in the least.
What matters more than anything
is that you're well.

Just come home to me safe and well,
and that alone
will be enough...... I'm always
waiting eagerly for your return.

note: Same JP as U02487; English kept consistent. Editorial: aligned with the edited U02241/U02487/U02750 (same JP).
Same JP as U02488; English kept consistent, including the page break before the request. Editorial: aligned with the edited U02243/U02488 (same JP).
Listener taken to be Motonari (cf. U03358, same soldier); 'sir' added for address. Editorial: 'my lord' instead of 'sir' (a Mouri soldier addressing Motonari).
